e.title: Insurance Fairness
e.summary: 保险定价代理歧视审计（burning-cost）：对齐 FCA EP25/2 / Consumer Duty / bias metrics
e.body: insurance-fairness（burning-cost）是保险定价的代理歧视（proxy discrimination）审计工具：检测定价变量是否作为敏感特征的代理，对齐英国 FCA EP25/2、Consumer Duty 与 bias metrics。对 RIAA：「定价公平不是口号，是可审计指标」的工程实现——与 [[insurance-fairness-ldp]]（隐私定价）、[[actuarial-pricing]]（定价）组成「公平定价」家族；培训课讲英国监管下的公平定价。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：仓库描述确认（FCA 代理歧视审计），未实测
e.summary_en: Proxy-discrimination auditing for insurance pricing (burning-cost): aligned with FCA EP25/2, Consumer Duty, bias metrics
e.summary_hk: 保險定價代理歧視審計（burning-cost）：對齊 FCA EP25/2 / Consumer Duty / bias metrics
e.body_en: insurance-fairness (burning-cost) is a proxy-discrimination audit tool for insurance pricing: detects whether pricing variables act as proxies for sensitive features, aligned with the UK FCA EP25/2, Consumer Duty and bias metrics. For RIAA: an engineering implementation of "pricing fairness is an auditable metric, not a slogan" — with [[insurance-fairness-ldp]] (privacy pricing) and [[actuarial-pricing]] (pricing) it forms a fair-pricing family; training sessions cover fair pricing under UK regulation.
e.body_hk: insurance-fairness（burning-cost）是保險定價的代理歧視（proxy discrimination）審計工具：檢測定價變量是否作為敏感特徵的代理，對齊英國 FCA EP25/2、Consumer Duty 與 bias metrics。對 RIAA：「定價公平不是口號，是可審計指標」的工程實現——與 [[insurance-fairness-ldp]]（私隱定價）、[[actuarial-pricing]]（定價）組成「公平定價」家族；培訓課講英國監管下的公平定價。
